fullPassage: In a study of police trainees in the US, Segal found that physical proximity had a stronger effect on attraction, in the short-term, than any other characteristic (such as age, ethnic background and leisure preferences). The trainees were assigned to seats in classrooms and to dormitories on the basis of the first letter of their surname. The closer together in the alphabet the first letters of the surnames of any two individuals were, the more likely they were to be friends. It is worth remembering, however, that physical proximity may increase the likelihood not only of liking someone else, but also of disliking them. A study by Ebbesen and others found that the most-liked others lived close by, but so did the most disliked others. Those who live close by have a greater potential for engaging in behaviours that annoy us (inconsiderate parking, being noisy), which increases the chance that we will dislike them.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

In a study of police trainees in the US, Segal found that physical proximity had a stronger effect on attraction, in the short-term, than any other characteristic.

(A) The closer together in the alphabet the first letters of the surnames of any two individuals were, the more likely they were to be friends.
(B) The trainees were assigned to seats in classrooms and to dormitories on the basis of the first letter of their surname.
(C) It is worth remembering, however, that physical proximity may increase the likelihood not only of liking someone else, but also of disliking them.

det.korean: B(성 배정 방식) → A(알파벳 근접 → 친구) → C(반전: 근접 = 반감도 증가) 순이 논리적 흐름
det.analysis: B에서 배정 기준을 제시하고, A에서 그 결과(친구 관계)를 설명하며, C에서 however로 반전을 도입한다.
det.tip: 배경 설명 → 결과 → 반전(However) 흐름을 파악하라.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

(A) Those who live close by have a greater potential for engaging in behaviours that annoy us, which increases the chance that we will dislike them.
(B) A study by Ebbesen and others found that the most-liked others lived close by, but so did the most disliked others.
(C) These behaviours include inconsiderate parking and being noisy.

det.korean: B(Ebbesen 연구: 가장 싫어하는 자도 근처) → A(이유: 귀찮은 행동 잠재력) → C(구체 예시: 주차·소음) 순
det.analysis: B에서 연구 결과를 제시하고, A에서 원인을 설명하며, C에서 구체적 예시로 마무리한다.
det.tip: 연구 결과 → 원인 설명 → 구체 예시 흐름을 기억하라.

questions.stem:

[주어진 문장] However, the same closeness that creates friendships can also generate conflicts and dislike.

① In a study of police trainees in the US, Segal found that physical proximity had a stronger effect on attraction. ② The trainees were assigned to seats and dormitories on the basis of the first letter of their surname. ③ The closer together in the alphabet the surnames were, the more likely they were to be friends. ④ A study by Ebbesen found that the most-liked others lived close by, but so did the most disliked others.

det.korean: ③까지 근접성의 긍정적 효과(친구 관계)를 설명하므로, 반전의 However 문장은 ④번 앞에 삽입된다.
det.analysis: However는 역접 신호어이며, ③(친구 효과) 이후 반전을 도입하여 ④(싫어하는 자도 근처)로 연결한다.
det.tip: 역접 신호어(However, But) 앞뒤 내용 전환 지점을 파악하라.

det.tip: 지시어(This, That, Such)가 무엇을 가리키는지 추적하라.

questions.stem:
우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.

[단어] in the short-term / physical proximity / a stronger effect / on attraction / had
questions.ans: Physical proximity had a stronger effect on attraction in the short-term.

det.tip: 'have an effect on + 명사' 관용 표현의 어순을 기억하라.

det.tip: potential for -ing 구문과 관계절 수식 어순을 확인하라.
